xmldoc.short_description: Differences between two messages, field by field.

param_input_item.param_description: two structs, or with a schema and a type two messages given as structs or as encoded uint8 bytes. With a schema, both are first read through it, so absent fields and default values compare the same way.
a schema from protobuf.load and a message type.

param_output_item.param_description: a table with one row per difference and the variables Path (a string such as "a.b(2).c"), Change ("changed", "added" in b, "removed" from a), A and B (cells with the values, [] when absent).

description.p: protobuf.diff lists the fields that differ between two messages. With a schema and a type, the two sides are decoded first, so a field left out of one struct and a field set to its default compare as equal, as they would on the wire.
